__inputs.name: DS_EOLSSU
__inputs.label: eolssu MySQL
__inputs.description: grafana 읽기 계정으로 만든 MySQL 데이터 소스

list.name: instrument
list.label: 악기
list.query: SELECT name FROM instruments ORDER BY id

list.name: song
list.label: 곡
list.query: SELECT s.title FROM songs s JOIN instruments i ON i.id = s.instrument_id WHERE i.name IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.title

list.name: model
list.label: 모델 버전
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model_version FROM evaluations ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 음표별 오차 (음을 못 잡은 MISSED는 빠짐. +는 높게·늦게·길게)
음높이 오차 분포 (cent, ±200 넘으면 끝 칸)
panels.description: 10 cent 구간별 음 수. 시김새 음은 판정에서 빠지지만 DB에 시김새 여부가 없어 여기에는 섞여 있다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(b AS CHAR) AS 오차_cent, n AS 음_수 FROM (SELECT FLOOR(LEAST(GREATEST(nr.pitch_error_cent, -200), 200) / 10) * 10 AS b, COUNT(*) AS n FROM note_results nr JOIN evaluations e ON e.id = nr.evaluation_id JOIN practice_sessions ps ON ps.id = e.session_id JOIN songs s ON s.id = ps.song_id JOIN instruments i ON i.id = s.instrument_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.evaluated_at) AND i.name IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND s.title IN (${song:sqlstring}) AND e.model_version IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND nr.pitch_error_cent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b) t ORDER BY b

panels.title: 박자 오차 분포 (ms, ±400 넘으면 끝 칸)
panels.description: 음 시작 시각 오차의 20 ms 구간별 음 수. 한쪽으로 쏠리면 시작 시각 계산이 밀려 있다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(b AS CHAR) AS 오차_ms, n AS 음_수 FROM (SELECT FLOOR(LEAST(GREATEST(nr.onset_error_ms, -400), 400) / 20) * 20 AS b, COUNT(*) AS n FROM note_results nr JOIN evaluations e ON e.id = nr.evaluation_id JOIN practice_sessions ps ON ps.id = e.session_id JOIN songs s ON s.id = ps.song_id JOIN instruments i ON i.id = s.instrument_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.evaluated_at) AND i.name IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND s.title IN (${song:sqlstring}) AND e.model_version IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND nr.onset_error_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b) t ORDER BY b

panels.title: 길이 오차 분포 (ms, ±1000 넘으면 끝 칸)
panels.description: 음 길이 오차의 50 ms 구간별 음 수. 판정 값에는 없고 길이 점수에만 들어가는 축이다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(b AS CHAR) AS 오차_ms, n AS 음_수 FROM (SELECT FLOOR(LEAST(GREATEST(nr.duration_error_ms, -1000), 1000) / 50) * 50 AS b, COUNT(*) AS n FROM note_results nr JOIN evaluations e ON e.id = nr.evaluation_id JOIN practice_sessions ps ON ps.id = e.session_id JOIN songs s ON s.id = ps.song_id JOIN instruments i ON i.id = s.instrument_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.evaluated_at) AND i.name IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND s.title IN (${song:sqlstring}) AND e.model_version IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND nr.duration_error_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b) t ORDER BY b
